entries.title: Auckland
entries.description: My first home in New Zealand. I rented a flat near the waterfront, caught the ferry to work, and spent weekends on Waiheke Island pretending I understood rugby.

entries.title: Wellington
entries.description: The windiest city I have ever called home. I worked in the local tech scene, became obsessed with flat whites, and learned to never trust an umbrella here.

entries.title: Queenstown
entries.description: A season in the adventure capital. I worked remotely by the lake, hiked the Remarkables on weekends, and jumped out of a plane exactly once.

entries.title: Christchurch
entries.description: The rebuild city. I lived near the Avon River, cycled to work through Hagley Park, and watched a city rebuild itself around me.

entries.title: Auckland, again
entries.description: I came back and it felt like coming home. Finally visited Hobbiton, learned to surf badly, and confirmed New Zealand still has the best coffee on the planet.
